description: Portable tool schemas for trusted wrappers. Hosts should inject tenant/scope and authentication from policy where possible.

functions.name: mimicrag_retrieve
functions.description: Retrieve ranked evidence passages without generating an answer.

functions.name: mimicrag_expand
functions.description: Expand bounded document-graph neighbors from a retrieved node.

functions.name: mimicrag_ingest
functions.description: Ingest approved text. Expose only behind a host approval boundary.

functions.name: mimicrag_trace
functions.description: Inspect one retrieval or answer trace by identifier.
